abstract: Highway work zones are critical edge cases for autonomous vehicles (AVs), combining atypical geometries and jurisdiction-specific regulations that existing benchmarks fail to capture: real-world datasets lack 360{\deg} multi-modal, full-scene 3D work zone annotation, and no single recorded site can span the layouts and regulatory variants needed for generalizable models. We present WorkIng, a dual-domain benchmark and training resource. WorkIng-Highway provides a 360{\deg} multi-modal work zone benchmark with synchronized 128-channel LiDAR, six RGB cameras, and RTK-GPS across 32 km, yielding 12,000+ annotated frames and 227,399 tracked 3D bounding boxes. WorkIng-CARLA complements this with procedural simulation spanning 24 regulation-aware scenarios across six canonical topologies and six international traffic standards, populated by 100+ custom 3D assets. Benchmarking representative 3D detection and end-to-end planning architectures shows that real-world data remains the primary performance driver, and that scenario-stratified synthetic augmentation improves architectures across 2D recognition, 3D detection, and trajectory planning. Resources: https://github.com/cvims/WorkIng
abstract_zh: 高速公路施工区是自主车辆（AVs）面临的重要边缘案例，结合了非典型几何形状和特定于管辖区的法规，而现有基准无法捕捉这些特征：真实世界数据集缺乏360°多模态、全场景的3D施工区标注，且没有单一记录站点能够涵盖通用模型所需的布局和法规变体。我们提出了WorkIng，一个双领域基准和训练资源。WorkIng-Highway提供了一个360°多模态施工区基准，配备同步的128通道激光雷达、六个RGB摄像头和RTK-GPS，覆盖32公里，生成了12,000多个标注帧和227,399个跟踪的3D边界框。WorkIng-CARLA则通过程序化仿真补充了这一点，涵盖了24种考虑法规的场景，涉及六种典型拓扑和六种国际交通标准，配备了100多个自定义3D资产。对代表性3D检测和端到端规划架构的基准测试表明，真实世界数据仍然是主要的性能驱动因素，而情景分层的合成增强在2D识别、3D检测和轨迹规划方面改善了架构。资源链接：https://github.com/cvims/WorkIng
